prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original square icon for Primer, a World of Warcraft class-guide addon that explains what to press, which talents to take and why, in the voice of a class trainer.
Style references only: the three supplied sibling-addon paintings show the exact family aesthetic: vivid painted inventory items, angular textured brushwork, chunky bevels, bright warm gold against deep rich coloured materials, and a dark navy square. Match the illustrator's hand and the scale of the central subject. Do not copy the keyring, open cookbook, or open codex.
Subject: a single closed, thick, slightly worn field training manual in richly saturated violet-plum leather. Show it from a mild three-quarter overhead angle so its cover is broad, dominant and almost front-facing, with the thick warm cream page block visible along the bottom and right edges. Four restrained chunky sculpted gold corner guards, burnished ochre shadows. Center one large, unmistakable embossed gold branching-path emblem on the cover: a single bottom diamond joined by three bold gold channels to three large top gems in gold settings, the central one a pale lavender diamond, the two outer ones a warm amber and pale turquoise. This is a simple three-way talent tree, geometric and legible, stamped into the book cover, not a botanical tree or a UI panel. The violet cover and the branching gold emblem must be the first things the eye sees. One small teal ribbon bookmark protrudes from the bottom edge. The overall effect is a treasured trainer's handbook that shows you how to find your own build.
Composition: one substantial hero object, centered, filling 85–90% of the square with all edges visible and a little breathing room. Set on a full-bleed opaque midnight-navy painted square with a soft cobalt vignette immediately behind the book and quiet dark corners. Warm highlights, cool violet shadows, thick painterly texture, clean bold silhouette at 32 pixels. No floating glyphs, foreground props, sparkles, auras, weapons, symbols of any specific WoW class or faction, thin filigree, words, letters, numbers, watermark, logos within the logo, scenery, frames, polished 3D rendering, mockup, or logo sheet. One finished image.
